summary: Almonty Industries announced a new share repurchase program authorized by its Board. The program permits buybacks of up to 14,400,000 common shares (about 5% of outstanding shares) for up to US$300,000,000 over 36 months from August 24, 2026 to August 24, 2029. Purchases may be executed on Nasdaq or alternative trading systems at market prices, under Rule 10b-18 safe harbors, and potentially via Rule 10b5-1 plans during blackout periods. Management cited undervaluation relative to strategic tungsten assets. Watch execution pace and potential price support effects.
